text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As curfew approaches, I spy Air Shakur
outside
her dorm chatting with some
friends.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fancy bumping into you at this hour,
Shakur.
Have you been off somewhere
staring at your
computer again?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Somethin' like that. And what has her
majesty
been up to?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm feeling a little peckish, so I
ordered
some cup ramen for delivery.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ramen is great during the day, but
wouldn't you
agree it's also fantastic at
night?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
By the time night rolls around, I've been
moving
around and using my head all
day. I've burned
through all of my
energy, so I'd say it probably
tastes
better than during the day.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? In that case, would you
care to join
me for some ramen right
now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Focusing on your computer all day
counts as
using your head, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nah. I can get all the nutrients I need
from
supplements. Eating at this hour
will only lead to
gaining unnecessary
weight.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Awww... but eating is so important. I
don't think
you ought to force yourself
to suffer hunger
pangs. What do you
think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You get it. That's clearly the most
efficient path.
choice_data_list: カロリー管理も大事、サプリで済まそう
我慢はよくない、しっかり食べよう

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come now... It's important to savor and
enjoy
your meals too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But I guess I shouldn't be surprised. You
two are
totally in sync.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: We're what now? I've got no clue what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur takes the usual route of
getting her
nutrients efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You can go ahead and keep your
opinions
to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See?! Even your trainer says it's fine.
Let's have
some ramen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And you just happened to have ordered two, huh? Seems like you were planning to rope me in from the start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Air Shakur gives in and joins
Fine
Motion for some late-night cup
ramen.
